about: docs/OPERATIONS.md §8.113 19 (C1, K1) and 20 (g): the hand examples of step 2 (試し). Inputs are made-up bars and numbers; every answer below was derived by hand from the rule (the 'why' of each case), not by running the program. research/chartbest-hand.ts runs each case through the program's own functions (CB_MODE=hand) and writes hand-results.json; a planted error of hook 'hand' (20 (f)) must make at least one of its named cases fail. Prices are mids unless a case says bid/ask. Times are UTC.

cases.why: i3: HH = max(100.100, 100.200, 100.150) = 100.200 < C 100.250 → s = +1 (BUY). i4 and i7 break upwards again but s is already +1. i8: LL = min(100.100, 99.980, 100.040) = 99.980 > C 99.850 → s = −1 (SELL). i9 breaks again: no signal. Target 0 from bar 0 (SQ-01); bar 0 is the first determined bar.

cases.source: 8 (鏡と e)
cases.why: A blind-table row at 2024-01-08 00:00 USD/JPY (E 150.000) in the mini period's first half. A: BUY reaches TP 150.100 (bar 1), SELL its stop 150.130 on the ask (bar 2) → e = 1 − 0 = +1. Strata by the hour of T: h7 signals +0.5 (wk A), −0.5 (wk B) / blind 0 (A), −0.5 (B); h8 signal +0.5 (B) / blind +0.5 (A), −0.5 (C); h9 signal +0.5 (C) has no blind → dropped.
